questions.question: E, F, G, H, P, Q, and R, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only three people sit between P and G when counted from the right of P. Only F sits between R and P when counted from the left of P. Only two people sit between R and E when counted from the left of R. H is NOT an immediate neighbour of G. How many people sit between F and Q when counted from the left of F?
questions.solution:
**Given**: E, F, G, H, P, Q, and R, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

Based on the given conditions, we get the following arrangement-

1. Only three people sit between P and G when counted from the right of P. Only F sits between R and P when counted from the left of P. From these, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05e6750880f613a96722ff3a6b050c3439b8114292eda0aa89c0961028165f45.png] 

2. Only two people sit between R and E when counted from the left of R. H is NOT an immediate neighbour of G. From these, we get the final arrangement as follows-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8de97d5f2af216a8263e077a051dca69aae6999d4e2d3da5c6aeaca39caeb09c.png] 

Therefore, **two people sit between F and Q when counted from the left of F.**

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **All girls are honest. Priya is honest.

**Conclusion 1:** Priya is a girl.

**Conclusion 2:** All honest people are girls.
questions.solution:
Given,

Statements:

All girls are honest. Priya is honest.

Conclusions:

I. Priya is a girl - False (Because, from the given statements, we only know that Priya is honest. However, it is not necessarily true that Priya is a girl just because all girls are honest).

II. All honest people are girls - False (Because, the statement only tells us that all girls are honest, but it does not imply that all honest people are girls).

So, None of the conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is 
**"Option 2"**.

questions.question: Six babies Ria, Sia, Tia, Urja, Vani and Winnie are born one after the other but not necessarily in the same order. All of them were born in different cities. Only two babies were born before the one who was born in Raipur. Only one baby was born between Sia, who was born in Delhi and the baby born in Raipur. Tia was born before Urja and just after the baby born in Haridwar. Tia was not born in Raipur. Ria was born in Bhopal and just before Vani. Tia is born immediately before the baby born in Ballia. Winnie was not born in Pune. Who was born just after Sia and in which city?
questions.solution:
Given: Six babies Ria, Sia, Tia, Urja, Vani and Winnie are born one after the other, but not necessarily in the same order. All of them were born in different cities.

1) Only two babies were born before the one who was born in Raipur.

__ > __ > Raipur > __ > __ > __

2) Only one baby was born between Sia, who was born in Delhi, and the baby born in Raipur.

__ > Sia (Delhi) > __ > Raipur > __ > __

3) Tia was born before Urja and just after the baby born in Haridwar. Tia was not born in Raipur.

Haridwar > Tia > Urja

4) Ria was born in Bhopal and just before Vani.

Ria (Bhopal) > Vani

5) Tia is born immediately before the baby born in Ballia.

Tia > Ballia

6) Winnie was not born in Pune.

From clue 1 and 2, we know that there are two babies before Raipur and one baby between Sia and Raipur. Therefore, the order must be:

__ > Sia (Delhi) > __ > Raipur > __ > __

Since Tia was born before Urja and just after the baby born in Haridwar, Tia cannot be born in Raipur. Therefore, the order must be:

Haridwar > Tia > Ballia

Also, Ria was born in Bhopal just before Vani:

Ria (Bhopal) > Vani

Combining all the clues, the final order must be:

1. Haridwar

2. Tia

3. Ballia

4. Sia (Delhi)

5. Raipur

6. Ria (Bhopal)

7. Vani

Thus, Sia is born in Delhi, and the baby born just after Sia is the one born in Raipur.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

'A × B' means 'A is the sister of B', and

It means:

• B is the husband of H
 
• H is the mother of C
 
• C is the sister of D
 
• D is the mother of E

Based on the relationships:

 
• H is the mother of C, and C is the sister of D.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
